scientific_stage: M2-B3 one-at-a-time graph propagation of the frozen M2-A4 diverse portfolio
purpose: Test whether independently confirmed public-I1 inverse ambiguity propagates to graph-level sigma when one provider surrogate is substituted at a time into the frozen M1 graph baseline.

variant_design.baseline: BASE_M1 uses the frozen confirmed M1 anchor for all three providers.
variant_design.alternatives: Substitute exactly one provider at a time with each of its three frozen M2-A4 final portfolio members while holding the other two providers at their M1 anchors.

graph_simulation.seed_bank_relation: Fresh relative to M1 25000..25099, original M2-B 26000..26099, and M2-B2 27000..27099.

graph_query.A_G_construction: Use the same public-I1-induced G0 admissibility boundary for every variant.
graph_query.comparison_reference: BASE_M1 on the same seed bank

next_gate: Inspect prediction spread versus BASE_M1 and within each provider's three A4 alternatives before any graph reference evaluation or 3x3x3 factorial.
